2018 Q4.bq: We delivered the respectable results for a fourth quarter, revenue for the fourth quarter was $1.88 billion at the high end of our outlook, driven by strong demand across majority of our end markets.

2019 Q1.bq: Revenue exceeded the high end of our outlook by $263 million, ending at $2.19 billion.

2019 Q2.bq: Revenue exceeded the high end of our outlook by $126.6 million ending at $2.13 billion.

2019 Q3.bq: Non-GAAP earnings came in at the high end of our outlook at $0.82 with solid free cash for $139 million.

2019 Q4.bq: While revenue was at the low end of our outlook at $1.9 billion, non-GAAP diluted earnings per share at $0.84 exceeded the top end of our outlook by $0.01.

2020 Q1.bq: For the first quarter, we achieved revenue of $1.84 billion and non-GAAP earnings per share of $0.79, both exceeding the high end of the guidance range.

2020 Q2.bq: Second quarter revenue of $1.6 billion, was down 13.6% sequentially and 9.1% lower than the midpoint of our original outlook provided in January.

2020 Q3.bq: Third quarter revenue of $1.65 billion was up 4% sequentially and exceeded our outlook of $1.5 billion to $1.6 billion provided in April.

2020 Q4.bq: Q4 revenue of $1.875 billion was up 13.3% sequentially and exceeded our outlook of $1.73 billion to $1.83 billion we provided in July.

2021 Q1.bq: Q1 revenue of $1.76 billion, exceeded the midpoint of our outlook of $1.7 billion to $1.8 billion.

2021 Q2.bq: Finally, Q2 non-GAAP fully diluted earnings per share of $1.01 exceeded our outlook of $0.76 to $0.86, primarily, as the result of the favorable mix in the CPS segment and management's focus on driving efficiencies.

2021 Q3.bq: Non-GAAP fully diluted earnings per share of $0.99 exceeded our outlook of $0.84 to $0.94, primarily as the result of better than expected gross margin.

2021 Q4.bq: Q4 revenue of $1.64 billion, was slightly below our outlook of $1.65 billion to $1.75 billion.

2025 Q3.bq: More specifically, our revenue of $2.04 billion, non-GAAP gross margin of 9.1%, and our non-GAAP diluted earnings per share of $1.53 all exceeded our outlook.

2025 Q4.bq: To be specific, our non-GAAP gross margin of 9.4% and our non-GAAP diluted earnings per share of $1.67 both exceeded our outlook.

2026 Q1.bq: Our revenue of $3.19 billion and our non-GAAP operating margin of 6.0% each came in towards the high end of our outlook.

2026 Q2.bq: Our revenue of $4.0 billion came in well above our outlook range, driven by strong execution and customer demand for the ZT systems business resulting in some accelerated compute shipments previously expected in the second half to shift into the second quarter.

2026 Q4.bq: Our core Sanmina business revenue of $2.97 billion grew 42% versus the same period a year ago, exceeding our outlook with broad-based strength across all of our end markets, several of which grew double digits year-over-year.
